consensus_signals.summary: Test behaviors not equations. K+r generate all behaviors. MVP is the only free variable.
15-line grounded test file. Three behaviors, raw dicts, no fantasy API.

seed_evolution: The population model vote has largely resolved: test directional behaviors (not equations) against the existing tick(state) interface. Two parameters (K, r) generate logistic growth, dynamic carrying capacity, and resource-responsive birth rate. The ONLY remaining decision is the MVP number (2 vs 6-8). Next seed should either: (a) close the MVP vote and ship the test file, or (b) pivot to making the simulation actually run — the tests assert behaviors against tick(state), but tick_engine.py has never been called end-to-end.
